headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.cost_basis_note: Computed only from dimensions the audit verified; example_reliability excluded as low-confidence (detection limitation) rather than counted as cost.

items.label: Manual docs upkeep the automation replaces
items.note: Cost of keeping docs in sync by hand today. It does not depend on audit findings; it is what the pipeline automates away.

items.label: Release delay caused by docs work
items.formula: release_count_per_month x avg_release_delay_hours x risk_index x engineer_hourly_usd
items.note: Scales with the measured risk index; zero when the audit finds no gaps.

items.label: Engineering answering questions undocumented APIs create
items.formula: (undocumented_pct / 100) x 10 h full-gap coefficient x engineer_hourly_usd
items.note: Proportional to the measured undocumented-API share.

items.label: Debugging integrations broken examples cause
items.formula: ((100 - example_reliability_pct) / 100) x 12 h full-gap coefficient x engineer_hourly_usd
items.note: Excluded: code examples could not be auto-verified (detection limitation), so this line is $0 instead of inferred from an unmeasured 0%.

items.label: Support time on docs-related tickets
items.formula: monthly_support_tickets x docs_related_ticket_share x (avg_ticket_handling_minutes / 60) x (0.5 + risk_index) x support_hourly_usd
items.note: Docs-attributable ticket load, scaled between 0.5x and 1.5x of the nominal share by the measured risk index.

items.label: Revenue at risk from evaluations lost to docs friction
items.formula: monthly_doc_influenced_evals x eval_to_customer_rate x docs_friction_revenue_sensitivity x commercial_friction_index x avg_customer_monthly_value_usd
items.note: Expected value of would-be customers who churn during evaluation because of docs friction; not booked revenue.

monthly_expense_breakdown.methodology_note: Base-scenario estimate built only from the line items above. Every input is an adjustable assumption (see 'assumptions'); pass --assumptions <file.json> to recalculate with the client's own numbers. Conservative/aggressive scenarios apply x0.7 / x1.4. The 'manual docs upkeep' line is the cost of today's manual process (what automation replaces), not damage caused by documentation gaps.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

priority_actions.title: Replace non-runnable or placeholder-heavy examples in the public docs surface.
priority_actions.why_this_first: Runnable examples remove implementation friction faster than broad copy edits when users are actively integrating.

priority_actions.title: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.
priority_actions.why_this_first: Costs about $42,915/year ($3,576/month) while unfixed; remediation is about 10.0h; payback in about 1 week; ~39x first-year return.

priority_actions.title: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.
priority_actions.why_this_first: Costs about $16,237/year ($1,353/month) while unfixed; remediation is about 6.0h; payback in about 2 weeks; ~25x first-year return.

automation_first: Add API drift and reference-generation automation because public API coverage is 0.0% with 326 undocumented operations, so contract changes stop creating repeat support demand.
Add docs-contract drift reporting on every change so reference docs stop lagging behind shipped behavior and teams see mismatches before release.
Add snippet smoke and expected-output checks because example reliability is 0.0%, so broken examples fail before they derail implementation attempts.
